SCRIPT.KOREAN: 음~ 근데 뭐 사람 달라진 거야 뭐.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Hmm~ Well, people changing isn’t a big deal.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 嗯~其实人员变动对我来说
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 嗯～不過，房客變動對我來說
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: うーん、でもまぁ、人が変わったって別に
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Hmm~ Yah, pergantian orang sih bukan hal besar.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Hmm~ bom, ter gente nova não é grande coisa.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Mmm~ bueno, que haya gente nueva no es gran cosa.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: هوم ~ خب، تغییر افراد کار مهمی نیست.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: It’s not really important to me.
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 俺にはあんまり関係ないですよ
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Itu nggak terlalu penting buat aku.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Pra mim, isso não importa muito.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Para mí, eso no importa mucho.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: What matters is that you’re there, Manager.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 重要的是課長你還在啊
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 課長がいることのほうが大事です
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Yang penting tuh kamu ada di sana, Manajer.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: O importante é que você esteja lá.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Lo importante es que usted esté ahí.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: آنچه مهم است این است که شما آنجا هستید، مدیر.

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 뭐야... 내가 유만 씨한테 그렇게 중요해?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: …What? I’m that important to you, Yuman?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 什么啊...我对你来说有这么重要？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 什麼...我在你心中有那麼重要嗎？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: えっ…なにそれ、そんなに私のことが大事？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: …Hah? Aku sepenting itu buat kamu, Yuman?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: O quê~? Sou tão importante assim pra você?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: ... چی؟ من خیلی برات مهمم یومان؟

SCRIPT.JAPANESE: もちろんですよ、すっごく大事です
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: البته - شما فوق العاده مهم هستید.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I get so anxious when you’re not around.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 你是我生活中不可或缺的存在
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 你是我生活中不可或缺的存在
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: いなかったらどれだけ気になると思ってるんですか
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aku tuh jadi cemas banget kalau kamu nggak ada.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Quando você não tá, não consigo parar de pensar em você.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Cuando no está, no puedo dejar de pensar en usted.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: وقتی تو نیستی خیلی مضطرب می شوم.
